coordinatePolicy: each sweep calibration + own ego -> global -> first LiDAR ego -> viewer; no object motion compensation
windowPolicy: first through last keyframe per sensor; current and at most 4 past sweeps; startup truncated

density.method: 38 shared keyframe times after startup; square +/-25m viewer X/Z around current ego, height [-3,8]m relative to ego; 2500m2; 0.25m 3D voxels; no static/dynamic segmentation

objectTrailProxy.method: past points inside devkit-interpolated same-instance box, outside current keyframe box expanded 0.25m; speed estimate >=1m/s
objectTrailProxy.limitations: geometric proxy, not semantic ghost ground truth; box interpolation, occlusion, overlap and boundary errors remain; no object motion compensation
